text_block_list.text:
Never has Сайленс Судзука appeared
more relaxed
than on the day of the
Kinko Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I encourage her to enjoy the race to the
fullest.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Taking my words to heart, she readies
herself for
the race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
